description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Modify a cash receipt issued today. Get aprv_no from hometax__cash_receipt__daily_issue__search. Fields you send are changed to those values; fields you omit (usage, issue means, transaction date/time) are taken from today's original receipt. When the original cannot tell whether VAT applies, the call asks for cshpt_trs_type_cd instead of guessing.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

cshpt_trs_type_cd.description: Transaction type code (거래유형코드): 01=과세, 02=면세, 03=간이 Optional — inferred from the original receipt's VAT; asked for when it cannot be inferred.

cshpt_usg_cl_cd.description: Usage class code (용도구분코드): 0=소득공제용, 1=지출증빙용 Optional — defaults to the original receipt's value.

rcpr_tin.description: Recipient TIN. Taken from today's original receipt when omitted.

spst_cnfr_cl_cd.description: Issue-means class code (발급수단구분코드): 01=주민등록번호, 02=사업자등록번호, 03=휴대전화번호, 04=카드번호 Optional — defaults to the original receipt's value.

spst_cnfr_no_enc_cntn.description: Issue-means number (발급수단번호) matching the class code, digits only. It is sent to the institution exactly as given - never encrypt or hash it, and never put an approval number here. Optional — defaults to the original receipt's value.

tota_trs_amt.description: Total transaction amount (총 거래금액, min 1 KRW, string)

trs_dt.description: Transaction date YYYYMMDD. Default: the original receipt's date (only today's receipts can be modified).

trs_time.description: Transaction time HHMMSS. Default: the original receipt's time.

name: hometax__cash_receipt__daily_issue__modify
title: 일일 현금영수증 수정
